events.title: Agentic Development and Context Optimization
events.summary: Consolidated context hierarchy, context/output efficiency, YAGNI, lifecycle, deterministic verification, independent verification by risk, completion states, and agentic operations.
events.notes: Includes the conditional Agentic Operations module: Human Validation Zones, progressive autonomy, context/session recovery, parallel-agent isolation, least authority, durable failure/Gotcha knowledge, and project-handler pinning improvements. EFF v2 predates this event and was preserved. The PRE-STANDARDS-2026-09-11 baseline cohort is SHA 6662773be213c56a0e6a2179c3be060bc04170bb; the event era begins at ce664dfbd36f7522fe8049fdd36230384a8e0e8f and includes its descendant minor revisions until a later event supersedes it.

events.title: Context Efficiency and Retrieval
events.summary: Added query-first retrieval, progressive disclosure, repeated-read control, command-output hygiene, optional Graphify and LeanCTX pilot protocols, and context-efficiency measurement schema.
events.measurement_objective: Measure context and tool-output efficiency by cohort while preserving acceptance, verification, correctness, traceability, and later outcome evidence.
events.notes: EFF v2 remains unchanged. This event begins at e627f1fd6ee114b76ee509abaaf40b251b0c734d; the append-only event-record commit is a descendant minor revision in the same era. No third-party optimizer, hook, proxy, global configuration, or generated graph was installed.

events.title: Observable Context Telemetry Capture
events.summary: Requires directly observable execution metadata to be recorded while preserving null for unavailable values and clarifying independent EFF and context-efficiency version fields.
events.measurement_objective: Improve completeness of directly observable execution metadata without inferring unavailable values or changing BASELINE behavior.
events.notes: EFF remains record version v:2; context-efficiency records retain schema_version: 1. Historical records, including historical nulls, are not rewritten. The append-only event commit is a descendant minor revision in this standards era.

events.title: Transactional Delivery Closeout Control Loop
events.summary: Formalized Codex-owned Notion synchronization and EFF persistence, re-fetch verification, dual acceptance, blocked closeout semantics, and reconciliation handoff.
events.measurement_objective: Measure complete delivery closeout and control-plane synchronization without weakening implementation evidence or altering EFF v2.
events.notes: The implementation agent completes routine transactional closeout. If configured Notion or the approved EFF ledger cannot be written and verified, valid implementation remains preserved and the required state is CONTROL-PLANE SYNC BLOCKED. EFF v2 is unchanged. This event begins at f54b2f1d6ae814b02a4d1aabab51d6503db2a865; the append-only event-record commit is a descendant minor revision in the same era.

events.title: Evidence-Based Performance Completion
events.summary: Permits successful zero-code performance completion when verified baseline evidence satisfies acceptance and no meaningful bottleneck exists, while requiring measured need and comparable evidence for optimization changes.
events.measurement_objective: Measure whether evidence-first performance completion reduces unnecessary optimization and rework while preserving verified acceptance and completion rates.
events.notes: EFF v2 is unchanged. A verified no-code performance story records files: 0 when accurate and retains the baseline measurement artifact as delivery evidence. This event begins at 015df91513648788f19545b5c109524adc084d57; the append-only event-record commit is a descendant minor revision in the same era.
